第1章 人不该死终有救（第1页）
灰蒙蒙的天空下，一片乱石嶙峋的空旷山岗，寒风凄厉地呼啸着，吹过一个个摆放毫无章法的废弃麻袋。
有的袋子破了洞，也不知是被虫蚁咬破还是被血水浸泡烂掉的，有的露出一只人的手骨，有的露出一只脚，有的被野兽撕咬剩下一些毛发或衣衫碎片，也有相对完好的，定是中毒或是烂掉的躯体发出阵阵恶臭，野兽都嫌弃。
一个丢弃死人的乱葬岗，连一床廉价的草席也没有。没人挖坑，哪怕一个浅坑掩埋也好。
一个个麻袋就这样裸露在外，一个个残缺尸体被人丢到这里与乱石为邻，与枯草为伴，天为被，地为床。风吹日晒，野兽践踏，最终从这个天地间消失不见踪影。
四周阴沉得可怕，枯草倔强的迎风飘舞，发出沙沙的声响，见证这些人的不幸。似轻声地吟唱哀歌，又似一个个冤魂相互讲诉令人听不懂的哀伤和冤屈，令人毛骨悚然。这地方本是人迹罕至之地，这时却走来一人。
一身着粗布褂子的刀疤汉子，阴沉着脸，扛着一个麻袋，一双眼睛四处打望。看来又是来丢弃尸体的，只是夜色下来此丢弃，一看就有猫腻。
刀疤汉子还未走到顶端的山岗上，寒风吹来一段朽木打击到他的脚踝上。刀疤汉子痛得酸爽，一跤摔倒在地，麻袋滚落一旁。汉子本能地顺手一抓，却抓了一个空。
麻袋翻滚过枯草沿着路边的斜坡滚到了山岗下，被荒草淹没，再也看不见。
刀疤汉子找了一圈，没找到，不由骂骂咧咧：“真是倒霉，既然你小崽子死后不愿到乱葬岗上面去凑热闹，也不用寻我晦气，就随了你愿在此享福。一枚低等神晶的辛苦费，我也算是尽心了。”说完也不和死人置气，头也不回地远离乱葬岗向东而去。
乱葬岗向东三百里有一个叫做“康庄”的村庄，说是村庄方圆数百万平方公里，人口数百万，高山湖泊、亭台楼阁、庄园集市应有尽有。
一个巨大的豪华庄园内，刀疤汉子正向一位衣着华丽的妇人汇报。
“回禀大夫人，小子已被丢到乱葬岗，明天一早定然尸骨无存。”刀疤汉子知道丢在乱葬岗的尸体，一大早就会被野兽分食，也不担心有人会发现麻袋滚落到草丛，那个鬼地方，谁都不愿意去沾染晦气。
“做得好，这枚神晶是你余下的工钱。不得对他人提起。否则，你是知道后果的。”黑暗中女人的声音冷冷的，随即消失不见。
刀疤汉子摸着手里的两枚神晶，很是满意，正常丢弃一个死人，只有一枚低等神晶，他接下这个活，工钱却是一倍，只是要求深夜丢弃到乱葬岗所在的山岗上，那样不会让人发现并且翌日一早尸体很快就没有了。
刀疤汉子回到自己的住地，摸着两枚神晶，美美地沉睡过去，再也没有醒来。
恶毒女人算无遗漏，刀疤汉子本不该知晓口袋里是什么人。但刀疤汇报情况时，口里的小子，出卖了他，肯定打开过袋子，看到不该看到的。
深信一个道理，死人才能保守秘密，其实刀疤即便没看，他口中的大夫人为了万无一失，也不能让他看到明早太阳的升起。

大夫人计算周密，然天不遂人愿，那口袋滚下山岗，被荒草淹没，刀疤汉子没有找着，是没有尽心找，懒得为一枚低等神晶过多的费事。
口袋在翻滚过程中被沿路的乱石朽木多次擦挂、口袋被划破，少年从口袋里跌了出来，一路翻滚，滚到了一行人的脚下。

Chapter 1 People who don’t deserve to die will eventually be saved (Page 1)
Under the gray sky, there is an empty and rocky hill. The cold wind howls miserably, blowing through the abandoned sacks arranged haphazardly.
Some of the bags had holes, whether they were bitten by insects or ants or soaked in blood and water. Some had a human hand bone exposed, some exposed a foot, some were torn apart by wild beasts, leaving some hair or pieces of clothing, and some were relatively intact. They must have been poisoned or rotten bodies emitted a stench that the wild beasts disliked.
A mass grave where the dead were discarded, not even a cheap straw mat. No one digs a hole, even a shallow one to bury it.
The sacks are exposed like this, and the mutilated corpses are thrown here next to the rocks and withered grass, with the sky as a quilt and the earth as a bed. It was blown by the wind and sun, trampled by wild beasts, and finally disappeared from this world.
The surroundings were terribly gloomy, and the withered grass stubbornly fluttered in the wind, making a rustling sound, witnessing the misfortune of these people. It's like singing a lamentation softly, and it's also like the ghosts of the enemy telling each other incomprehensible sorrows and grievances. It's creepy. This place was originally an inaccessible place, but now a person came.
A scarred man in a coarse cloth coat with a gloomy face was carrying a sack and looking around with his eyes. It seems that they are here to dump the body again, but at night, they are dumping it here, and there is something fishy about it.
Before the scarred man reached the top of the hill, the cold wind blew a piece of rotten wood and hit his ankle. The scarred man was sore with pain that he fell to the ground and the sack rolled aside. The man instinctively grabbed it, but found nothing.
The sack rolled over the withered grass and rolled along the slope of the roadside to the foot of the hill. It was submerged in the grass and could no longer be seen.
The man with the scar searched around but couldn't find it, so he couldn't help but curse: "It's really unlucky. Since you don't want to go to the mass grave to join in the fun after your kid dies, you don't have to seek bad luck on me. I can just enjoy your happiness here. For the hard work of a low-grade divine crystal, I can't help but curse." After saying that, he didn't get angry with the dead man, and walked away from the mass grave to the east without looking back.
There is a village called "Kangzhuang" three hundred miles east of the mass grave. It is said that the village covers millions of square kilometers and has a population of millions. It has mountains, lakes, pavilions, manors and markets.
In a huge luxurious manor, a scarred man was reporting to a gorgeously dressed woman.
"Reporting to Madam, the boy has been thrown into the mass grave. There will definitely be no bones left tomorrow morning." The scarred man knew that the corpses thrown into the mass grave would be eaten by wild beasts early in the morning, and he was not worried that anyone would find the sack rolled down into the grass. No one wanted to contaminate the bad luck in that damn place.
"Well done, this divine crystal is your remaining wages. Do not mention it to others. Otherwise, you will know the consequences." The woman's voice was cold in the darkness, and then disappeared.
The scarred man touched the two divine crystals in his hands and was very satisfied. Normally, there was only one low-level divine crystal for discarding a dead person. He accepted the job and the salary was doubled. He only asked that they be discarded late at night on the hill where the mass grave was located, so that no one would find it and the corpse would be gone soon the next morning.
The scarred man returned to his residence, touched the two divine crystals, fell asleep beautifully, and never woke up again.
A vicious woman has no omissions, and a man with a scar should not know who is in his pocket. But when Scar reported the situation, the boy in his mouth betrayed him. He must have opened the bag and saw something he shouldn't have seen.
He firmly believed in the truth that only the dead can keep secrets. In fact, even if Scar didn't look, the lady he said would not let him see the sun rise tomorrow morning for the sake of safety.
The lady calculatesZhou Mi, but his wish failed, the bag rolled down the hill and was submerged in weeds. The scarred man didn't find it, because he didn't look for it with all his heart, and he was too lazy to bother too much for a low-level divine crystal.
During the tumbling process, the bag was repeatedly scratched and scratched by the rocks and dead wood along the road. The boy fell out of the bag and rolled all the way to the feet of the group of people.
